alignment.inventory: Exact frozen objective is QUOTITIVE grouping: known whole and group size, unknown number of groups. Two bagupScene demos8 objects with2 or4 per bag. pic: g2/3/5,q2..5 adjusted to differ, whole=g×q, choices distinguish g and q±1; grouping hint and repeated-sum explain. fill: g2/3/4/5,q2..4 adjusted ifequal, constructive bagup task. story: g2/3/4,q2..4 adjusted ifequal, differentiate whole/one-group/groups. transfer: g2/3,boxes2/3,2bags perbox, two-stage grouping; deliberately kept optional scope, not silently required. bagupFrame/Scene preserve pile/items per formed bag; ui.bagup adds one full bag per click, reversible, animated450ms; engine check compares bag count n/g. Our no-timer controlled groups form from conserved pile; no arbitrary individual taps. All exact cases plus q=g case9/3 included. Audit row24; COVERAGE omits fill and has stale global revision. No own family declaration or SIMS overlay; index fills GOALS, audit revision retained.
alignment.limitations: Supported model actions are narrower than physical action or independent/deferred understanding.
